cards.ex: The tech industry is really survival of the fittest; you have to constantly innovate.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya sohasi haqiqatan ham eng moslashgan omon qoladi; doimo yangilik yaratishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda eng kuchli va moslashgan organizmlar omon qoladi degan nazariya.

cards.ex: Hikers need to be prepared to face the elements in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Sayohatchilar tog'larda ob-havo elementlariga duch kelishga tayyor bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning yomon sharoitlariga duch kelish, ularga bardosh berish.

cards.ex: Mother Nature can be both beautiful and destructive.
cards.exUz: Ona tabiat ham go'zal, ham vayron qiluvchi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatning o'zi, uning kuchlari va hodisalari.

cards.ex: She's been as busy as a bee getting ready for the conference.
cards.exUz: U konferentsiyaga tayyorgarlik ko'rish bilan asalari kabi band.
cards.uzDef: Juda band, tinimsiz ishlayotgan odam haqida.

cards.ex: Without security, the company's data is a sitting duck for hackers.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizliksiz kompaniyaning ma'lumotlari xakerlar uchun o'lja.
cards.uzDef: Himoyasiz, oson hujumga uchraydigan odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: She got the lion's share of the inheritance.
cards.exUz: U merosning arslon ulushini oldi.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta qismi, eng ko'p ulush.

cards.ex: The wildlife sanctuary provides a safe haven for endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiat qo'riqxonasi yo'qolib borayotgan turlarga xavfsiz boshpana beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yovvoyi hayvonlarni himoya qilish uchun yaratilgan hudud.

cards.ex: I can nip the change in the air; something big is about to happen.
cards.exUz: Men havodagi o'zgarishni his qilyapman; nimadir katta voqea sodir bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yaqinlashayotganini sezish, his qilish.

cards.ex: We have to let nature's course take over and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiat qonunining o'z yo'liga qo'yib, nima bo'lishini ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy jarayonlar, voqealarning tabiiy oqimi.

cards.ex: He's on thin ice with his boss after missing the deadline.
cards.exUz: U muddatni o'tkazib yuborganidan keyin xo'jayini bilan xavfli vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her ideas were a breath of fresh air in the stale company.
cards.exUz: Uning g'oyalari eskirgan kompaniyada yangi nafas edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, tetiklantiruvchi narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: It's nice to escape the concrete jungle and go hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Tosh o'rmondan qochib, tog'larda piyoda yurish yoqimli.
cards.uzDef: Binolar va yo'llar bilan to'la shahar, tabiat kam.

cards.ex: The money we raised is just a drop in the bucket compared to what we need.
cards.exUz: Biz yig'gan pulimiz bizga kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan bir tomchi xolos.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik miqdor, katta muammoni hal qilish uchun yetarli emas.

cards.ex: Strawberries are more expensive when they're out of season.
cards.exUz: Qulupnaylar mavsumdan tashqari paytida qimmatroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir mahsulot yoki faoliyat uchun odatiy vaqt emas.

cards.ex: He couldn't resist the call of the wild and set off to explore Alaska.
cards.exUz: U yovvoyilik chaqirig'iga qarshi tura olmadi va Alyaskani o'rganish uchun yo'lga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Yovvoyi tabiatga bo'lgan kuchli istak, sarguzashtga chanqoqlik.

cards.ex: That technology is as dead as a dodo; nobody uses it anymore.
cards.exUz: Bu texnologiya dodo kabi o'lik; endi hech kim uni ishlatmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay o'lik, yo'q bo'lib ketgan, ishlatilmaydigan.

cards.ex: If you think I stole your pen, you're barking up the wrong tree.
cards.exUz: Agar siz mening ruchkamni o'g'irlading deb o'ylasangiz, noto'g'ri yo'lga tushyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri odamni ayblash, noto'g'ri yo'nalishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He turned out to be a fair-weather friend; he disappeared when I needed help.
cards.exUz: U do'st nomi do'st bo'lib chiqdi; yordamga muhtoj bo'lganimda g'oyib bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: Let's clear the air and talk about what's bothering you.
cards.exUz: Keling, muhitni tozalaylik va sizni bezovta qilayotgan narsalar haqida gaplashaylik.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki noaniqlikni bartaraf etish, munosabatlarni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: Their personalities are as different as night and day.
cards.exUz: Ularning shaxsiyatlari tun va kunduzdek farqli.
cards.term: as different as night and day
cards.uzDef: Juda farqli, hech qanday o'xshashligi yo'q.

cards.ex: We wanted to get off the beaten path and explore some hidden villages.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlardan uzoqlashib, yashirin qishloqlarni o'rganmoqchi edik.
cards.uzDef: Odatda sayyohlar bormaydigan, kam odam yuradigan joylarda.

cards.ex: They're making hay while the sun shines and expanding their business rapidly.
cards.exUz: Ular quyoshda pichanni quritib, bizneslarini tez sur'atlar bilan kengaytirmoqdalar.
cards.term: make hay while the sun shines
cards.uzDef: Qulay imkoniyatlardan foydalanib qolish.

cards.ex: The new product launch created a feeding frenzy among investors.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulotning ishga tushirilishi investorlar o'rtasida ochko'zlikni keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Katta ochko'zlik, ko'p odamlar nimadir uchun kurashmoqda.

cards.ex: Despite his size, he's as gentle as a lamb.
cards.exUz: Uning kattaligiga qaramay, u qo'zichoq kabi muloyim.
cards.uzDef: Juda muloyim, mehribon, yumshoq xarakterli.

cards.ex: She's a force of nature in the business world.
cards.exUz: U biznes olamida tabiat kuchi.
cards.uzDef: Qarshilik qilib bo'lmaydigan kuchli ta'sirga ega bo'lgan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: I needed to get it off my chest, so I told him how I felt.
cards.exUz: Men buni dildan aytishim kerak edi, shuning uchun unga o'z his-tuyg'ularimni aytdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni bezovta qilayotgan narsani aytish, yengillashish.

cards.ex: His problems stem from a difficult childhood.
cards.exUz: Uning muammolari qiyin bolalikdan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir kelib chiqish, sababi bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new business is starting to take root in the community.
cards.exUz: Yangi biznes jamiyatda ildiz ota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatli rivojlanish, o'rnashib qolish.

cards.ex: Looking for that document is a wild goose chase; it doesn't exist.
cards.exUz: Bu hujjatni qidirish befoyda izlanish; u mavjud emas.
cards.uzDef: Befoyda, samarasiz izlanish, vaqtni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The storm cut off the electricity to the entire town.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron butun shaharning elektr energiyasini kesib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Aloqani uzmoq, ajratib qo'ymoq.
